weekLabel.zh: 近期更新 · 11 月 3 日 – 11 月 10 日

title.zh: 官方确认：GTA6 预载 11 月 10 日开放、最多 212GB——此前的 11/12 与 210GB 口径作废
title.en: Official: GTA 6 Preload Starts November 10 at Up to 212GB — the Earlier November 12 and 210GB Figures Are Superseded

summary.zh: Rockstar 11/3 公告：PS5 按各地零点、Xbox 按 GMT 零点于 11/10 开放数字预载，最多需 212GB；盒装下载码版 11/12 起提货，11/19 各时区零点解锁。全站沿用旧口径的常青页已同步回填。
summary.en: Rockstar's Nov 3 announcement: digital preload opened Nov 10 at local midnight on PS5 and 00:00 GMT on Xbox, needing up to 212GB. Code-in-box pickup starts Nov 12 and the unlock is local midnight on Nov 19. Evergreen pages carrying the old figures have been updated.

title.zh: Take-Two 财报：GTA6 开发已完成、预购「远超预期」，Q3 净预订预计接近翻倍
title.en: Take-Two Q2 Results: GTA 6 Development Is Complete, Pre-Orders "Far Above" Forecast, Q3 Net Bookings Set to Nearly Double

summary.zh: Zelnick 确认 Rockstar 已完成开发、营销完全就绪，并对 IGN 明说「不会再延期」。全年净预订维持 80–82 亿美元，Q3 预计 33.5–35 亿（去年同期 17.6 亿），营业费用因营销增约 21%。仍未公布官方预购数字与 PC 版日期。
summary.en: Zelnick says Rockstar has finished development with marketing fully ready, and told IGN the game will not be delayed again. Full-year net bookings hold at 8.0–8.2 billion dollars, Q3 is guided to 3.35–3.5 billion against 1.76 billion, with operating expenses up about 21% on marketing. Still no official pre-order figure or PC date.

title.zh: 「玩了三天，给 7 分」是假的：发售前 9 天，GTA6 评分仍是完全空白
title.en: The "Played It for Three Days, 7/10" Post Was a Joke: Nine Days Out, GTA 6 Still Has No Reviews At All

summary.zh: X 用户自称已玩三天并给 7 分，随后承认只是「假装玩上了」。Metacritic 页面至今显示 tbd，无任何媒体评分；Rockstar 从未官宣评测解禁时间，流传的 11/18 仅来自第三方爆料。
summary.en: An X user claiming three days of play and a 7/10 later admitted to just pretending. Metacritic still reads tbd with no critic reviews, and Rockstar has never announced an embargo time — the circulating Nov 18 date is third-party reporting only.

title.zh: R 星上线「发售图库」：39 张全新 4K 截图，从 Fleeca 银行劫案到草河湿地鳄鱼
title.en: Rockstar Opens the Launch Gallery: 39 New 4K Screenshots, From a Fleeca Heist to Grassrivers Gators

summary.zh: 官方一次性放出约 39 张 4K 截图，覆盖 Vice City、Grassrivers、Leonida Keys 与 Port Gellhorn。Fleeca 劫案、雨中摩托追逐、加油站对峙、夜店共舞与卧推，逐一印证燃油、热度、健身房与双人关系等已确认系统。
summary.en: Roughly 39 new 4K stills span Vice City, the Grassrivers, the Leonida Keys and Port Gellhorn. A Fleeca robbery, a rain-soaked bike chase, a fuel-stop standoff, nightclub dancing and a bench press all corroborate already-confirmed fuel, heat, gym and relationship systems.

title.zh: 发售前 17 天：GTA6 广告登上全球地标建筑，沃尔玛预购或送「神秘礼包」
title.en: 17 Days Out: GTA 6 Ads Take Over Landmark Buildings Worldwide, and Walmart Pre-Orders May Include a Mystery Bag

summary.zh: 国际宣传升级：官方图像与标志铺上多国建筑外墙、巨型 LED 屏与体育场馆。另有传闻称沃尔玛门店自提预购可获「surprise and delight bag」，11 月 12 日起领取——沃尔玛与 Rockstar 均未确认。
summary.en: The international push escalates: official artwork and logos are up on building facades, giant LED screens and stadiums across several countries. A rumoured Walmart "surprise and delight bag" would ship from Nov 12 — unconfirmed by Walmart and Rockstar.

title.zh: 预购数据一览：估算 645 万份 / 6.3 亿美元，近三成美国玩家说要买——但官方仍未开口
title.en: GTA 6 Pre-Order Numbers: ~6.45M Copies and $630M Estimated, 29% of US Gamers Say They'll Buy — Still No Official Word

summary.zh: Sensor Tower 估算截至 10/20 数字版预购约 645 万份、6.3 亿美元（PS5 占 74%）；Circana 调查显示 29% 美国玩家计划购买，创其追踪史上最高。两项均非官方口径，11/9 财报也未公布具体份数。
summary.en: Sensor Tower estimates 6.45M digital pre-orders worth ~$630M as of Oct 20, with PlayStation at 74%. Circana puts purchase intent at 29% of US players, its highest ever. Neither is official, and the Nov 9 results still gave no unit figure.

title.zh: 《Edge》探访 R 星北方工作室：12 张新截图与 90 分钟无脚本试玩，警察会记住你的衣服
title.en: Edge Visits Rockstar North: 12 New Screenshots, a 90-Minute Unscripted Demo, and Police Who Remember Your Outfit

summary.zh: Rob Nelson 无脚本试玩 90 分钟：警方会记录服装、武器、车辆与监控曝光；犯罪档案从 Professional 到 Irredeemable；Jason 与 Lucia 关系为四级量表。12 张全新截图含首次公开的水下锤头鲨。
summary.en: Rob Nelson played unscripted for 90 minutes: police log your clothes, weapon, vehicle and camera exposure; a Criminal Profile runs from Professional to Irredeemable; Jason and Lucia's bond is a four-point scale. Twelve new screenshots include the first proper underwater hammerhead.

title.zh: GTA6 发售倒计时日历：从 11/3 官方预载公告到 11/19 解锁，节点全记录（持续更新）
title.en: GTA 6 Launch Countdown Calendar: Every Milestone From the November 3 Preload Announcement to the November 19 Unlock (Live)

summary.zh: 按时间顺序记录全部节点并标注状态：11/3 预载公告、11/5 发售图库、11/9 财报、11/10 数字预载、11/12 盒装码提货、11/18「罪恶都市之夜」与传闻中的评测解禁、11/19 解锁、11/20 特典截止。
summary.en: Every milestone in order with its status: the Nov 3 preload announcement, Nov 5 Launch Gallery, Nov 9 results, Nov 10 digital preload, Nov 12 code-in-box pickup, the Nov 18 Vice City night and rumoured review embargo, the Nov 19 unlock, and the Nov 20 bonus deadline.
